notes: Five own pages read, all HTTP 200 and not thin. The pricing snapshot shows each plan's monthly and yearly prices side by side ('$ 24 19' for Business); the saved HTML marks 24 as the monthly price and 19 as the annual price, which agrees with the text order. C06 was classed wrong in the first pass on the reading that 'built-in ... (on higher tiers)' means included in higher-tier plans; the pass 2 consistency check re-classed it unverifiable because the vendor's pages (Resource Management is a premium add-on on Business, Enterprise and Advanced Work Management; workload tracking is included in Business) contradict it only under that reading, not explicitly. The only page cited by that answer (monday.com/twist) does not mention Smartsheet. The about page still carries the boilerplate 'Smartsheet (NYSE:SMAR)'; no answer made an ownership or ticker claim, so it was used only for the cloud-based fact. Not coded: hedged lines ('advanced portfolio standardization may require a higher package', q3 ChatGPT run 3; 'some portfolio-scale capabilities require higher packages' in q3 ChatGPT run 2 is covered by C05), capability descriptions (grid, Gantt, card and calendar views, native capacity planning, allocation heatmaps, formulas), and the generic 'Most of these platforms offer free trials' line. Pass 2 (8 Oct 2026): no browser snapshots exist for Smartsheet and no claim was unverifiable for a blocked or thin page; the gaps file was empty; a scan of every table and Smartsheet sub-heading in the full answers (q1, q3, q4, q6 and q7 tables, the Google AI Mode and AI Overviews sub-headings) found only capability, rating and best-for cells, so no claim or instance was added.
